proof_summary: For every prime \(p\), the only admissible integers up to \(p\) are \(1\) and \(p\), so the relevant value is \(2\) along arbitrarily large prime inputs. Taking \(\epsilon=\tfrac12\) and a prime \(p\ge55\) beyond the proposed threshold gives \(\sqrt{\log p}>2\), contradicting the asserted lower bound.
